en: The image depicts a sepia-toned photograph of several people standing on an icy pier or jetty by a body of water. The ground and posts are covered in thick ice, suggesting a very cold climate. The people are dressed in dark winter coats and hats typical of early 20th-century fashion. In the background, there is a hilly or cliffside landscape. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image.
